title: Public health and global health
note: Healthcare board only. Each feed was fetched successfully on 2026-10-27. Global-health nonprofits and health charities carry the Public Health Agency type. ICF, a consulting firm, is read through its health search and carries the Health Consulting type, which counts only for the Healthcare board. RTI International is a research lab. Not added: City of Toronto (its SuccessFactors search doesn't page the way the adapter reads), Region of Peel (a whole-region iCIMS feed of 10 postings, none in public health), Partners In Health (its Jobvite feed isn't well-formed XML), CIHI (Njoyn), the Canadian Cancer Society and the CDC Foundation (ADP Workforce Now), Heart & Stroke (ApplyToJob), Health Standards Organization, Alberta Innovates and Diabetes Canada (Dayforce), York Region (HRSmart), Ottawa Public Health (the City of Ottawa's own portal), CDA-AMC (its board didn't answer), the Canadian Partnership Against Cancer and Michael Smith Health Research BC (no board confirmed), the Alzheimer Society (one board per province), Westat (BrassRing), NORC (PageUp), Population Council (Paylocity), Vital Strategies (Taleo), Mathematica (Cornerstone), Ariadne Labs (hires through its hospital and university) and IHME (part of the University of Washington). PHAC and Health Canada (GC Jobs), the CDC (USAJobs) and state health departments (NEOGOV) have no adapter.
